clause: Combine into variant set / extract member + variant-property editing [STU-DS-006a]

scope.summary: Implement combining separate components into a variant set and extracting a member back to a standalone component, plus adding, renaming, reordering, and value-editing variant properties on the set. All operations are typed commands with an operator variant editor surface.
acceptance_criteria: combine/extract + variant-property add/rename/reorder/edit; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: variant editor reachable via author_id; combine/extract + add/rename/reorder/edit variant properties
test: combine yields one variant set; extract yields a standalone component; property edits update the schema

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Building variant sets

risk_if_missed: No variant authoring; variant sets cannot be built or maintained.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
